title: Chapter 582
text:
Boom boom boom!

On the brown earth, the two of them collided again and again like dragons and snakes fighting. They slithered across the earth and exchanged punches, constantly landing heavy blows on each other's bodies. Shockwaves burst out continuously, as if a hurricane had been set off.

The shockwaves of the battle quickly destroyed the terrain, and the entire area became filled with holes.

Malekith's overall level was very high, and his strength was even stronger. Although close combat was not Han Xiao's forte, he had [Berserk Throw]. He was able to throw Malekith out like a softball time and time again, interrupting the explosive attacks of the Pugilist.

Han Xiao could escape from this place at any time, but he was very interested in Malekith's background. Thus, he decided to stay and fight. After all, the BlackLight Stealth was already patrolling in the sky, and he could escape at any time.

Activating the nano transformation function of the Berserk Ape mechanical suit, Han Xiao switched to [Giant Ape Form]. The mechanical suit was like cells multiplying, and a large number of components suddenly appeared, stacking on top of each other. Han Xiao quickly turned into a small giant that was even taller than Malekith. His strength increased once again, and the power of [Berserk Throw] also increased.

Both of them were Calamity Grade Supers, and they both had powerful defense and recovery abilities. Han Xiao stabilized his footing, and the situation was in a stalemate.

After fighting for a while, Malekith's eyes flashed, and he suddenly opened his mouth with a hint of excitement in his tone. He was a battle maniac, and to him, finding an opponent that he could fight to his heart's content gave him a thrill that was many times stronger than mating.

"You're stronger than the rumors say. I'm going to be serious now. Don't die so easily."

The next moment, Malekith softly chanted a long string of Demonic Language, and the flames around his body surged. His eyes were like blazing flames, and black and red flames spewed out from the gaps of his armor. His aura soared, and the surrounding temperature rose rapidly. The air became distorted.

"The talent of the Demon Race, Advanced Stage True Name Liberation!" Han Xiao's eyes narrowed. In this state, the overall strength of the Demon Race would increase greatly. With Malekith's strength as a Calamity Grade, the increase was extremely shocking.

Bang!

Han Xiao's vision blurred as the ground receded rapidly. Malekith, who was in his giant ape form, was sent flying into the air. In the next second, Malekith, who was still on the ground, closed in on Han Xiao in the blink of an eye. Malekith's leg, which was surrounded by purplish-black flames and blackish-red flames, was like a guillotine, slashing towards Han Xiao's head. It was extremely fast and ear-piercing.

If he were to be struck by this kick, his neck would be torn apart and his entire body would be paralyzed. It would take half a second for him to recover, and for a Pugilist like Malekith, half a second was enough for him to execute a series of simple explosive moves.

Immediately deactivating the Great Ape Mode, Han Xiao's body shrank back, and his leg brushed past the mecha's helmet. It missed by a hair's breadth, and the scalding wind it brought along smeared his face.

After missing his attack, Malekith clasped his hands together and prepared to pummel Han Xiao to the ground.

At this moment, Han Xiao's helmet suddenly opened up, revealing a fiery vortex in the depths of his eyes. The next moment, two incandescent beams of fire shot out from his eyes, giving Malekith a Love Explosion.

Boom!

Malekith's attack was interrupted once again.

There were different types of demons. When using the True Name Release, one could clearly distinguish them. For example, those that breathed fire were Flame Demons, and those that breathed ice were Frost Demons. Malekith clearly had the bloodline of a Flame Demon, so his resistance to fire was extremely high. Although the damage of this attack was limited, it successfully pushed him away.

Han Xiao placed some genetic medicine into the injection module of the mecha. Just now, he injected Befuli's genetic medicine and used his one-time use Character Summon Card.

After obtaining a breather, Han Xiao did not hesitate and directly activated the third transformation of the Berserk Ape Mode, Berserk Overload Form!

The miniature high-density nuclear reactor operated at high power, and the power of the weapon and the mecha's attributes were all significantly increased!

Han Xiao put his arms together and activated the nano weapon module. The armor on both his arms merged together, forming a huge cannon barrel. Light beams shot out from it and struck Malekith from afar. Small mushroom clouds appeared on the ground as Han Xiao activated the nano weapon module.

Rumble!

Malekith endured the bombardment and moved forward. He also raised his hands and shot out Shockwave Blast.

The two of them shot at each other, and one of them moved forward while the other retreated. After True Name Release, Malekith's speed increased tremendously, and he gradually shortened the distance between them. Soon, he was in front of Han Xiao again.

His fist, which was surrounded by flames, went straight for Han Xiao's chest.

Weng!

At this moment …

Han Xiao's body exploded with shocking electric arcs. His heavy fist was like a bolt of lightning, and it landed on Malekith's face first.

Bang!

This punch was like a thunderbolt that exploded out of nowhere!

The shockwave spread out from Han Xiao's feet, and the ground within a hundred meters of him cracked and caved in!

As for Malekith, he had already turned into a shooting star and disappeared from sight.

[Power Explosion]!

If it was a melee attack, the damage would be increased by 650% – 700%, and there would be additional energy explosion and splash damage. There would be a 65% chance of causing a critical hit, and there would be additional debuffs such as knockback, knockback, and stun!

Not only had he used one skill, he had also used [Gene Release] at the same time, which was [Flaming Will] that had been strengthened by the Skill Upgrade Card!

The power of the skill had accumulated to a terrifying level!

Malekith had been sent flying for more than ten kilometers!

He would only be able to land after flying for a while!

"Hu … hu …"

Han Xiao panted softly. Melee combat was the most exhausting. His health and energy were still very healthy, but his stamina had decreased by quite a bit.

Fortunately, stamina recovery was usually in percentage form. The higher the upper limit, the faster the recovery.

"This guy is really strong, much stronger than Degulish and Nagojin. That attack just now probably only caused him some light injuries."

Han Xiao was hesitating whether or not to continue fighting. Suddenly, a thought flashed through his mind, and he recalled Malekith's background.

"A core officer of Bloodshed Land, one of the eight Vanguard Officials under Heber the Tyrant … He's a Beyond Grade A subordinate?"

Han Xiao immediately became alert. Why would another Beyond Grade A officer find him?

This time, a rolling smoke dragon appeared in the wilderness far away. It was Malekith running back. This time, he did not charge over but stopped a few dozen meters away from Han Xiao. He had already deactivated his True Name Release form, and there was a red fist print on his face.

"Well done, Black Star. You're an opponent worthy of my full strength. I really enjoyed the battle just now."

Malekith revealed an appreciative smile.

Even after activating his True Name Release form, he could not completely suppress his opponent and had even suffered a small loss. Black Star was very strong, even stronger than many people had guessed. There was no doubt about that.

He had already achieved his goal for this trip.

"I know your identity, Malekith. You're from Bloodshed Land."

Han Xiao did not want to continue fighting. He only wanted to know the purpose of Malekith's visit as soon as possible. Frowning, he said, "Why did you attack me? And why are you here? "

"I came here especially for you." Malekith touched the broken horn on his head.

Black Star was the Dragon Emperor's trusted officer. The Black Star Corps had been in the limelight recently, and he had been ordered to pay attention to Black Star's movements and find an opportunity to test him.

When the Purple Snake Space Pirates kidnapped the mercenaries of the Black Star Corps, Bloodshed Land's intelligence network had coincidentally found out that Malekith was nearby. Thus, he had stolen the spaceship of this group of space pirates and waited for Black Star to come to him. Without anyone disturbing him, he would be able to figure out Black Star's strength.

If Black Star was strong enough, then …

"Floating Dragon will only bury talents like you. You should have greater achievements. With your strength, you should be on the same level as me and become the ninth Vanguard Official." Malekith finally expressed his intentions and threw out an olive branch.
